During his lifetime, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]] led a '''Crime Syndicate''' that destroyed the [[Rath Cartel]] and [[Vandelhelm Combine]] in the [[Syndicate Wars]]. Eventually, despite Drayen's good fortune, he was betrayed by one of his [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]], which motivated him to destroy his entire syndicate, excluding his personal [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Chelah]] and his daughter [[Risha Drayen|Risha]].
